response.overview: To earn money for his ailing father's medical expenses, Ma Er needs to attend a job interview.  The process is constantly haunted by past experiences, like a nightmare, which he responds to with intense, frantic behavior.  9032024 is a sequel to the award-winning short film Even Ant Strive For Survival, a work that resonates with the times.  Viewers concerned about Hong Kong politics will easily understand Ma Er's anxiety and see the director's strong self-expression.  Used as the director's debut work, the independent and free creation is highly symbolic.
response.title: 9032024(Even Ant Strive For Survival part 2)
